2026_plan_236_diesel_replacement_project.warning: Project budget includes all 256 planned vehicles; it cannot price the 39 diesel buses separately.

illustrative_39_diesel_early_retirement.assumption: All 39 planned 60-ft diesel buses enter service at start-2026 and leave at start-2033 after seven years; 17-year useful life; 2019-CAD unit price approximately 1.0m; no resale value included.
illustrative_39_diesel_early_retirement.warning: Book-style straight-line exposure is not the actual incremental resource cost or a delivered-bus price. Selling/redeploying buses and a true 2023-dollar price change the result.

interpretation: The 203 named CNG/diesel vehicles in these plans would need to leave strict all-electric service by 2033 if procured and still operating; they are not verified deliveries and other non-electric programs may exist.
double_count_warning: The 2025 plan's 45 articulated BEBs for 39 retiring diesels is an earlier project description. The 2026 plan's 39 articulated diesels within a larger 236-bus project may overlap it. They are not added together.
